quest.title: Between Facades and Familiar Faces
quest.description: It's now time to attend Hu Tao's dinner. You head to Xinyue Kiosk with Paimon in tow...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: ...Ohh, so that's how it is! Thanks for the suggestions, Mr. Zhongli! I have them all noted down.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: I've long heard that your knowledge encompasses all things old and new, Mr. Zhongli, but I never knew that you were well-versed in the art of cooking, too.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: It is truly an honor to make your acquaintance.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: No need for formalities. I, too, feel humbled to be in the company of such talented young people. There are many things I could learn from you.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Oh, y—you flatter us!

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Um, if it's possible... May I trouble you to provide a few words of guidance for my practices in exorcism...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Exorcism? I can't say I'm an expert in the field, but if you don't mind, we could start by discussing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! There's so many people here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: All we knew was that Hu Tao invited Zhongli over. Paimon never thought we'd be meeting so many old friends, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Happy Lantern Rite, everyone!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Happy Lantern Rite!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Likewise. Please, take a seat.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Happy Lantern Rite! Are you having fun?

choices.text: I'm learning a lot.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Me too. I've seen Xinyan perform before, but this is the first time I've watched something like this.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I heard that the audience loved it too, and she's been receiving quite a lot of performance invitations lately. She's more busy than ever, and Yun Jin's gonna help her.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Yep, and they asked us to pass on their season's greetings to everyone. They hope we'll have a wonderful gathering.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: The performance was spectacular indeed. However... it gave Xiangling a huge burst of inspiration, which in turn gave us a bit of a headache...

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: "Us"? Did Xiangling ask you to try out her dishes too?

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Ahaha! That, my friend, is beside the point. Watching you eat was enough for me, haha.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: (Come to think of it, I probably shouldn't have burdened Chongyun with eating my share too...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hold on, Xiangling came up with a new recipe? *gasp* Let Paimon try!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: See? Someone here knows how to encourage people! Thanks, Paimon!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Oh, and I have to thank Mr. Zhongli too. He gave me lots of useful pointers that really drove it home for me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, so that's what you were talking about before we arrived!

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Yes. Since we'll be dining together, the topic of our conversation naturally revolved around cooking.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Xiangling's ideas are truly unconventional. Her choices in both ingredients and spices are comparable to a melody dancing on the tongue.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: My suggestions were nothing more than the icing on the cake.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohh! The two of you always deliver!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Hehe... Now I'm getting embarrassed...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Anyway, I'll get everyone to have a taste after I've adjusted the recipe based on Mr. Zhongli's advice!

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Hmm... That sounds like it might become a little safer to eat.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: How about I sample the dishes next time?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of eating... Paimon feels like we're missing someone...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hu Tao was the one who invited us, but she's not here! And, oh, where's Guoba?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Oh, Guoba volunteered to help dad at the restaurant!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: You know, lots of people come over to eat during Lantern Rite. Without Guoba helping out, I probably wouldn't have had the time to accept Hu Tao's invitation.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: As for Hu Tao...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: The director went to collect a guest. She asked me to stay here and host you for the time being.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Seems like it's almost time...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, Hu Tao went to fetch someone in person? Oh, that must mean they are super important!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Could it be... Keqing? Ningguang? Or... Captain Beidou?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: She didn't clarify. And, as her subordinate, I couldn't just pry into the details, could I?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Suddenly, the door to the restaurant bursts open as if struck by a hurricane...

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Ta-da! We're~here!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: We're not late to the party, right? Right?

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Good thing the Conqueror of Demons and I are both as swift as the wind. And whoosh! We made it just in time!

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: I see... so the important guest is the Conqueror of Demons. I've been looking forward to meeting you.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: The director didn't mention anything when she invited us. What a pleasant surprise... Gathered here with us tonight are not only young and accomplished individuals, but also the protector of Liyue's peace, Adeptus Alatus.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: To convene here with all of you is indeed a great honor.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Uhhh...

choices.text: I've become musically cultured.

talks.objective: What once happened in Wangshu Inn...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...It's almost Lantern Rite, yet you took all the trouble coming here...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: *sigh* The director has a way of making it difficult to decline...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Rex Lapis... May I ask what troubles you?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The director asked me to buy sesame oil in preparation for the celebrations.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Then why would you... come all the way to Wangshu Inn...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I had a pleasant chat with Chef Yanxiao and received some spices from him. And... see? Here's some matsutake and a portion of ham.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: What about the sesame oil...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Mm... It's a shame. I couldn't find the kind the director was looking for.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I'm sure you're exaggerating, Zhong— Ahem, Sir.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Ugh, there he goes again! Enough with the pleasantries. Go let our guest take a seat.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Everyone here today is well-known in their own field and has probably heard about one another to some extent. Some of us are even old acquaintances, so there's no need to be this formal.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: #I heard that the Conqueror of Demons and {NICKNAME} are pretty close, no?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're old friends.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Great! You two sit together!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: You should take a seat too, Director.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Oh? Finally remembered me?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: When we arrived just now, the hosts at Xinyue Kiosk told me our dishes are almost ready. Perfect timing.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Let's not wait any longer and ask them to bring out the food.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The delicious-looking food arrives, and a pleasant scent fills the air. You all cautiously begin eating while conversing quietly...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon would've never guessed the person Hu Tao went to fetch was Xiao...

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: #That's also the first I've heard of {NICKNAME} and Paimon being friends with the Conqueror of Demons.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You know Xiao too?

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: "Knowing" is a bit of an overstatement. I've always looked up to him.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: You might not know this, Paimon, but we exorcists have worked in close collaboration with the Conqueror of Demons for many generations, dispelling evil together, both in the open and from the shadows.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Hard to imagine that thanks to Hu Tao, I've finally gotten the chance to meet him... Conqueror of Demons, I am honored to make your acquaintance.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Likewise.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: It is a great honor indeed to have a chance to meet the legendary Conqueror of Demons. Chongyun has brought that name up quite a few times in the past.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: I remember you mentioning wanting him to understand the importance of exorcists...

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Ahem!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Uh, we know each other too!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: He helped try my dishes during the Masterful Chefs cook-off!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Hehe, I didn't think we'd have the chance to meet again. Happy Lantern Rite!

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: No anecdote, however, compares to meeting you in person. I'm Xingqiu, Xiangling and Chongyun's friend. The pleasure is all mine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, everyone's getting all formal and polite all of a sudden... Paimon doesn't know what she should say anymore...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, Adeptus Xiao... Mighty Conqueror of Demons! Please accept Paimon's greetings, too! Belated Happy Lantern Rite!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Belated" isn't the right word to use here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon tried very hard to look for a fancy word, okay? Don't be too harsh on Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: There's no need to be so polite.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: ...Tch!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: You're right. This was meant to be a nice little get-together between friends, after all. Too much formality kills the atmosphere.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: I didn't plan this gathering only for everyone to walk on eggshells, ai ya!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's your true intention, then...?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: A little get-together between friends, sipping the finest tea, and watching lanterns float into the sky. Bidding farewell to the past, and embracing the present with joy.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: And that is something our consultant would say. I think it deserves a standing ovation.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Indeed. Exceptional acting skills, Director.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: As for me, I'm just here to have fun and treat everyone to something good!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: We all worked really hard this year. Whether traveling or guiding...

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Cooking, helping with the family business, exorcising evil spirits, or conquering demons...

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: And of course, our consultant, who's been helping out at the parlor every now and then.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Everyone has done some pretty amazing things.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: As the one who brought everyone together, it goes without saying that I'm the one most deserving of praise!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. Sounds kinda self-important, but Paimon thinks it's pretty amazing that she managed to talk Xiao into coming... He rarely ever enters Liyue Harbor, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm curious about how she did it.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: It wasn't as complicated as you think.

talks.objective: What once happened in Wangshu Inn...

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: ...Okay gotcha, thanks, boss lady!

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: It's not boss lady, just boss!

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: And there she goes... What a lively girl.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Conqueror of Demons! Adeptus Xiaaaaao!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Guardian of Wangshu Inn! Hero of Dihua Marsh!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: I know you're thereeee!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Tch...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Quiet! Do not disturb the peace.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Sorry! But you wouldn't show up if I didn't yell your name, would you?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...I know you. You're the 77th Director of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Is there something you need?

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Haha, that does sound like one of Hu Tao's antics.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Did the Conqueror of Demons agree to come so that Hu Tao would stop pestering him...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: There might be other reasons.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Hehe, smart guess.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Huh? There's more to it?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: It gets pretty boring from here on. I talked about the funeral parlor's past relationships with the Guardian Yakshas — you know, just to be sociable.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: In the time of the Archon War, disputes were frequent, and disaster overtook the land. Humans couldn't escape from the torment of the plague, nor could they escape death.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The adepti vanquished the demons, the Millelith fought valiantly, and Wangsheng Funeral Parlor was responsible for purifying the diseased and sending off the spirits of the dead.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: That is how the border between life and death was maintained during the war, and it effectively prevented further incidents from happening.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: That's right! One point for the consultant!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: But despite our deep-rooted connection, it still took me quite a while to actually convince him.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Was he worried about his karma?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: You know him pretty well, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: This matter is out of my control, so I need to be cautious.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: True, but I've kept that in mind too! That's why everyone here today is in one way or another acquainted with elemental power.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Besides, it'll only be for a short while as we dine together. There won't be any lasting consequences.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: But I didn't... expect there to be so many people.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: There's no need to worry, Conqueror of Demons. We're not feeling anything unusual so far.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Our young exorcist over here is protected by his pure-yang energy, so he's probably the most resilient.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Th—That's not the same!

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: And did you just toss your carrots into my bowl? Hey, don't look away!

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Huh? What?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I'm siding with Chongyun. I saw that too!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: You're lucky Guoba isn't here today. He hates seeing people being picky with their food — if he'd seen that, he'd definitely make you eat all your carrots!

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Huh!? Guoba would do that? Is he that uncompromising?

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: But now that I think of it, Xiangling told me that Guoba used to be the Stove God...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Hahaha, it sounds like you've heard the rumors.

choices.text: You seem pretty quiet today. Is everything okay?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I'm doing fine.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Not long ago... before Lantern Rite, I met an old friend.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Thanks to his help, things have been a lot more stable than before.

choices.text: That's good to hear. Give everything you don't eat to Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right! ...Wait, what?
Whoosh... whoosh...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Huh? The wind?)
"Seeds of story, brought by the wind..."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "...and cultivated by time"!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah! Did Paimon just unconsciously complete that saying?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That voice... Could it be...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (It must be...!)

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Hm? If I'm not mistaken, there's someone knocking at the door.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Don't just sit there, Zhongli! Go welcome our guest in!
No such need! I'm coming in!

choices.text: An old friend?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: You should know him. He's...

choices.text: Not used to being around so many people?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The door to the restaurant gets blown open by a gust of wind again...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hehe, you finally let me in!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hello, hello! No matter if we've met before or not, this moment marks a brand-new encounter! Old friends and new, happy Lantern Rite!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! It's the Tone-Deaf Bard!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Ooohh! He seems to carry a valiant breeze wherever he goes... It looks like we're gonna be friends!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Fate has brought us together, so c'mon, take a seat and be my guest! Help yourself, I'll ask them for another set of cutlery.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Mhm, this young lady here is as bright as a fresh bouquet of flowers and the morning's rising sun. She no doubt is the one with the most authority here!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Whoa, these dishes look amazing... Is it really okay for me to join in? Hehe, alright, I'm digging in!

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Oh! Isn't this Zhenyu...

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Mm? Zhenyu?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Oh no, he's gonna give Xingqiu's pen name away...)

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Yep, now that I've taken a closer look... You're a fan of Zhenyu's works, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I met Xingqiu at a light novel convention. Ah, how I wish we'd met sooner!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I never expected that there'd be another person in this world who could interpret Zhenyu's new novel as thoroughly as I could!

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Venti, you're being too humble. Considering your poetic talent, your fundamentals are way more impressive.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Ahem... Could this new guest be Master Xingqiu's friend?

choices.text: He's my old pal too.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Yeah! Xiao, you remember me too, right? We had a chat not long ago.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...Yes, yes.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Monsters become more active than usual as we get closer to Lantern Rite.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I was patrolling Dihua Marsh a few days ago when I happened to run into this... this...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Hm? You've already forgotten? I'm a bard, remember?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: And bards go around singing wherever they like!

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Oh, right, and this bard was performing in Dihua Marsh.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: It was a... moving melody, and it made me feel relaxed and at ease. I... couldn't help but stay and listen.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Hehe, thank you for your patronage!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So that's how it was. I see.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: I understand now, too.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: I'm Zhongli, currently working at the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. It's a pleasure to meet you, new friend.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Mm-hmm, and I'm his boss. Oh, and if there's anything unsatisfactory, let me know anytime!

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: That's very considerate of you.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Oh? Hmm, no wonder. Only a boss as savvy and reliable as you would be able to hire such an impressive consultant!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Hehe, you're too nice, Venti.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Not to brag, but our consultant truly is impressive. His knowledge extends across the stars and the land, and there's nothing throughout history that he doesn't know.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: From the sophisticated way he speaks, it's hard not to suspect that he could very well be an adeptus in disguise! Hehe.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Xiao, you're an adeptus! Do you think it might be possible?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...Sorry, I'm only good at conquering demons. I'm afraid I don't have much knowledge in that matter.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, really?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But Paimon thinks you're super knowledgeable...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Paimon, play along!)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, ohhhh! Riiiight...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, Xiao's a warrior. He doesn't come to the city very often, so it's, uh, pretty normal for him to not know anything... Yeah...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Ehhh? Really?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: I've actually heard a few things about Mr. Zhongli before.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: The guests in the tavern talked about this refined and courteous man who, instead of having wine at Mondstadt's finest tavern, ordered a cup of hot tea with the most complex name.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: ...Now that you mention it, I seem to recall that there indeed is a musician like yourself in Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: I've heard that he's elegant and amiable, his works witty and vibrant. It's no overstatement to regard him as the best bard in Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Now you're making me embarrassed.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: I would say that Mondstadt's poetry is a little run-of-the-mill sometimes.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: There's one I heard a while back that went: "The old house is renewed, welcoming the spring breeze, awakening old memories."

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: The meaning's there, but the word choices are unimaginative, and there's a distinct lack of literary flair.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: I think so too. The composition needs a little jazzing up.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: If I were to give it a go, I'd make it...

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: "An old melon on a vine, a new flower that grows fine."

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Ohh, good one! It feels unique, and has a nice ring to it!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: You have great taste, Venti, I was right about you! Let's shake hands.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Of course, of course!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: ...Hey, Xingqiu.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Hmm?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Mind lending me a few books when we get back? Pick out some well-written ones.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I don't know if it's my own lack of literary knowledge, but I couldn't tell the difference between those two...

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: I don't think it's your fault...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Chongyun's right. It's not our fault.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Paimon, watch and learn from Hu Tao and Venti. This will come in handy for your ugly nicknames.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohh, you have a point!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But speaking of, why is the Tone-Deaf Bard here? Are you here to take part in the Lantern Rite too?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: I heard that Liyue will be hosting a Lantern Rite music festival this year. As a musician myself, how could I possibly resist the temptation to come take a look? ...Or a listen?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Getting to know other musical styles is essential to sparking inspiration, don't you think?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Huh, but the music festival wasn't planned beforehand...)

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: As for the Fontaine friend who hosted the festival, I saw him near Stone Gate the other day.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: The Iridescence Tour has finally been held successfully for once, so I had to congratulate him.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thank you. He must feel very grateful.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Don't think anything of it!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: By the way... I was watching as you entered Xinyue Kiosk, but no one seemed to notice me.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Should I say that it's because I'm an expert in hiding, or that a certain someone deliberately ignored the sound of the wind...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Haha... Whenever Lantern Rite comes around, Liyue Harbor becomes bustling with activity.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: People are all busy watching the lanterns and strolling around the shops, and they might just go travel somewhere on a whim. It is rather difficult to predict another's whereabouts.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: The festival is in full swing and proceeding smoothly, and we're all gathered here with friends new and old. This is no doubt a wonderful occasion worth celebrating.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: To come together with all of you at the beginning of the year, one can't help but be filled with joy.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: In a moment like this, I propose we raise a glass together. In my case, tea in lieu of wine.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Uh...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Very well said, Mr. Zhongli! That was exactly what I wanted to say!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Ah, now I'm getting a little self-conscious. I didn't cause you too much trouble barging in like that, did I?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: We usually drink wine during occasions like this over in Mondstadt, but since Mr. Zhongli insists on drinking tea, I'll give a toast with tea too! Everyone, thanks for the treat!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: You're welcome! As the host of this gathering, I hope everyone enjoys the food and drinks. May this year be better than the last!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Considering that everyone may have other matters to attend to later, sticking to tea seems like a good idea.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Uhhh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, all of a sudden, they started proposing toasts! Should... should we...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Xiao!

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: What's with the urgency!?

choices.text: Are you done eating? Wanna head out for a walk?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Sure.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Have you two finished eating?

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: It's always nice to have a breath of fresh air after a meal. Helps with digestion.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, uh, Paimon will come, too...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're still hungry, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh... yeah...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Don't worry, we'll be back soon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay then... Don't forget to come back!

choices.text: I ate too much. Could you come take a walk with me?
Looks like Xiao knows him, too.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I should be the one asking you that.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I... it's hard to describe.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Unfamiliar with gatherings like this?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: It's not that.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: There were those among the adepti who loved gatherings and idle chit chat. Sometimes, they would call up a few others for a drink. Even I got dragged along to their gatherings, many times.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: The adepti all have their specialties, making most of them proud and arrogant. Everything they say is straight from the heart... It never gets too complicated.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: But this time...

choices.text: I understand. It's all Zhongli's fault.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: That's not what I meant!

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Or perhaps I should say Zhong... Rex Lapis is really good at adapting to human life. You could say that he actually enjoys doing so.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: And that's something I might never be able to do.

choices.text: You don't have to be like them.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Hmm... That does sound like something you would say.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: No matter. I know my circumstances.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Whenever I think of the ordinary conversations I've had with you, it feels... strangely novel.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Strange in a good way?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Yes.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: The parlor director went out of her way with the invitation, so it was difficult to turn her down. I had made mental preparations before agreeing to come.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: She told me that all the guests today would be "acquainted with elemental power," and I knew that you would be here.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: But I didn't expect the other guests to be...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No one would've guessed.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: General Kapisas always said that we should live in the present and enjoy every pleasant surprise. Perhaps that's what I should do with what I'm feeling now.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...But I think he meant designing clothes for those around him.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: The clothes were intricately designed, but inconvenient to wear. Brother Bosacius never tried to hide his distaste in front of him.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Rex Lapis did like his designs and even collected quite a few. The outfit he wears now was also designed by General Kapisas himself.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I never saw him wear this during the war. I didn't expect him to start wearing it later.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Oh, here you are!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Um, I'm not intruding, right...

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: You're not. What is it?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Hu Tao saw that everyone's done eating and asked the staff to bring out the desserts.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Paimon got so anxious that you weren't back yet that she scarfed down her dessert without the usual slurping and munching.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But not so anxious that she can't eat. Sounds like she'll be okay.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: To be honest, I was kinda worried too.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: You looked a little restless just now, and I thought you weren't used to the food here and was planning to head back to Wangshu Inn for something Yanxiao made.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: You're worrying too much.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Xiao, don't pull any Lemniscatic Wind Cyclings on us.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...Why would I.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Anyway, let's head back.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Please wait!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: There's another reason why I came looking for you.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Here, take these. I brought them for you!

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...Almond Tofu?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Yup!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Since the Masterful Chefs competition, you could say that Yanxiao and I are not only competitors, but good friends as well! I visit him at Wangshu Inn sometimes to discuss our cooking.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I heard him say that the esteemed guest on the roof loves nothing more than a good plate of Almond Tofu, so I learned a thing or two about the dish from him.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I'll be honest... Before Hu Tao invited everyone, she secretly came looking for me, told me about the guests she planned to invite, and asked me for some suggestions on what she should order.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: So I made a few servings of Almond Tofu for you guys in advance! Take them as a token of gratitude for your support.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: When I told Guoba that I was making these for you, he started eagerly running around the kitchen and helping a lot too!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thank you, Xiangling and Guoba!

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Thank you for the trouble, there was no need to...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ahem...

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...I'll take them. Thank you... and Guoba too.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: You're welcome!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Oh, the Almond Tofu I made probably tastes and feels a little different from the type Yanxiao cooks. Please let me know if there's any improvements I should make!

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Okay.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Hehe, that's all!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Alrighty, we should head back now. We can't keep Paimon waiting!

choices.text: You do you.
I understand. It's all Venti's fault.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: N—No, I didn't mean that...

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: So you know his true identity. I'll get straight to the point then.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: The Anemo Archon is a free spirit, and his temperament is as carefree as the music he plays on the flute. It's easy for a god like him to live in harmony with humans...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, you're finally done whispering secrets to each other!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So much for promising Paimon you'll be back soon, hmph!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We were pretty quick. You're only angry because you have no sense of time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: H—How could you say that to Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph, in that case, besides "having no sense of time," Paimon will let you know what having no sense of fullness looks like!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Your dessert is all Paimon's!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Sorry to keep everyone waiting.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: No worries, we're all just chatting here. There's no serious business to take care of.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Whether we're chatting outside or inside, it's all the same.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Strive to be more like Hu Tao, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph, Paimon's too busy eating to talk to you.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: But even though we're all well-acquainted by now, I think this festive gathering deserves something ceremonious.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Oh? Is this some local custom?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Nope.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: This is something I made up so that good luck will be on our side, that's all!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Spontaneity is the best choice to make here! Um, let's use this incense burner on the table.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: It's been lit for so long now that the incense is running out. I'll leave refilling and lighting the incense to the most distinguished guest among us all.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Lighting the incense will signify continuous growth and prosperity in all our endeavors in the new year!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I see. Perfect symbolism, as expected of Hu Tao!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: And speaking of the most distinguished guest here today... I'm sure we all agree that it's Mr. Zhongli.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I'm not very familiar with the details of his past deeds, but chatting with him has been a real eye-opener, even for a bard who has traveled all across the world.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: If knowledge were a form of power, one could even say that you're a wielder of unlimited strength!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: But when it comes to having a way with words, the notable bard is certainly one cut above the rest.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I just happen to have a good memory. It is such an unexceptional skill, yet you made it sound like an unparalleled talent. I am truly impressed.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Since we all get to nominate someone...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I think it's only fair that we let the parlor director light the incense.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Huh, that won't do! Don't flatter me just because I'm your boss!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: We are looking for the most distinguished guest here. As the host, I shouldn't be involved in this discussion at all!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Now that we've enjoyed this tableful of delicacies, how about we let our one and only chef here do the honors?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Um, is this really the way this works? I didn't cook any of these dishes!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: It's not a big deal!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Just look at her! Xiangling, the disciple of an adeptus, the Stove God's best companion, the winner of the Masterful Chefs competition.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: The only heir of the famous Wanmin Restaurant, a good old friend of mine. There's no better choice!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh, why does Paimon feel like we're back at square one again?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: P—Please, stop! You're making me embarrassed!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: If we're looking for a distinguished guest... surely the second son of the Feiyun Commerce Guild counts? It's one of the largest commerce guilds in Liyue Harbor!

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Eh, don't get me involved in this!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Oooh, not a bad choice. With the commerce guild's young master lighting the incense, we're all sure to make a huge sum of Mora in the new year.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: That's not how it works!

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Making a fortune is indeed a fine wish, but it's of lesser importance than good health and happiness.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Which means we should choose Chongyun, the skilled exorcist who keeps everyone's home safe from evil spirits.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Huh? Now you're nominating me?

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: I can't be the one when we have the Conqueror of Demons right here!

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Adeptus Xiao has the most seniority among everyone here today. We should...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I refuse.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I am most certainly not the most distinguished guest here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Is he going to say it's Zhongli...)

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: You should all be able to make the right judgment based on your observations.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Wait, don't...)

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: One person here is well-acquainted with everyone else.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, that's right!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Even though you're always mocking Paimon, you're still pretty popular with other people!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, wait! Paimon said she wouldn't talk to you again...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm not the only well-connected person here though.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Who else is there?

choices.text: You, of course.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh... Huh!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Does that mean... Paimon's the most distinguished guest?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, that was unexpected, ehehe...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: I agree. Paimon's just the one we need.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Without a friend constantly by your side, a long journey would become dreadfully lonesome.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: But once you have someone there to brighten up the atmosphere, everything along the way will become lively and vibrant too.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Ah...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: #{NICKNAME} has traversed many nations and left behind a great deal of fascinating stories. But without Paimon, they would've become quite monotonous.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Paimon plays an indispensable role in making your journey a happy and smooth one.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You guys, Paimon's not used to being praised like that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, those were genuine compliments, right?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Of course. You're the best travel companion ever!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Thank you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You made Paimon wait for a long time, but Paimon's not mad anymore!

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Don't take everything to heart, Paimon. Friends tease each other all the time.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Hmm... That is indeed true.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: #That means Paimon is as important to {NICKNAME} as Guoba is to me!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Looks like we've come to an agreement! Any objections before we proceed?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: #I trust {NICKNAME}'s judgment.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Then Paimon it is!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: And now, the world's most excellent traveler's greatest companion, guide, and friend — Paimon! — will be refilling and lighting the incense for us!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Here you go, take the match... and don't burn yourself! But if things go really wrong, here's a two for one coupon.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Amidst everyone's laughter and applause, Paimon clumsily lights the incense...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You all have a relaxed heart-to-heart chat all the way until nightfall.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Now that everyone's had their fill of delicious food and tea, it's time to say goodbye.

choices.text: Take a look in the mirror.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: It's getting late. I won't take up any more of your time. You're all free to go as you please.

choices.text: The food and desserts were delicious.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep! The tea was amazing, too!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: You don't have to go all polite on me. Just remember to come when I invite you next time!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Hmm... Let's see...

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: It's dark out, so I'm going to accompany Xiangling, Xingqiu, and Chongyun back home. As for the rest of the guests, I'll leave them to our consultant.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: No need. I'm headed towards the harbor to meet a friend on the ship. There's no need to trouble one such as Mr. Zhongli.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: I think you know the place I'm talking about. Come meet me anytime!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I will.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: It was great getting to know you all. Let's meet again when the spring breeze begins to blow!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Bye! We should write poetry together sometime!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: We'll catch you all later then.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Don't forget to return to the parlor later. There's something I need you to do!

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Understood. See you later.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Bye!

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Well then...

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Rex Lapis...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Just Zhongli will do.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: I live as a mortal in Liyue Harbor now. I am just one among many who begin work at sunrise, and retire to rest at sundown.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: If we were to consider status and seniority, as Zhongli, I should be respectfully referring to you as Adeptus Xiao.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Heaven forbid!

choices.text: Adeptus Xiao!

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...Not you too!

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Haha, I meant what I said.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: I heard that during the Lantern Rite music festival, you conferred with Streetward Rambler and Cloud Retainer. I take it as you've gained a lot more knowledge about the past?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: The same truth will sound different coming from different people. As more bear witness to a story, feelings and interpretations expand in variety too.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: I once had a pleasant chat about the past and present with a Sumeru scholar named Soraya, and learned a few things about her research topic.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: From the evidence she found and the conclusions she made, her area of research is already very close to the truth.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: But there are multiple sides to humans and gods alike.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: In the legends recorded by humans, some gods were depicted as arrogant and condescending, while others were kind and capable.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: But whether to me, Streetward Rambler, Cloud Retainer, or younger adepti such as Xiao and Ganyu, those adepti and gods that may seem extraordinary to humans are something more akin to close companions.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: This was as true back then as it is right now.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: #Just as Xiao may seem unapproachable to most, but {NICKNAME} has proved otherwise.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: So there's no need to dwell too much on certain things.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Rex La— I mean, Zhongli, what you're saying is...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: It looks like you understood what I meant.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Ah...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: The director asked me to accompany you on your return, but I don't think you'll need my protection. I'll be taking a walk around and admiring the night scenery.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: After that... it'll be time for me to go back and meet up with the director. Goodbye for now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Bye, Zhongli!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Everyone's gone now...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon always feels a little empty inside when a lively celebration ends...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But at least you'll always stay by Paimon's side!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #No no no, Paimon got it mixed up! Paimon, the best and most distinguished travel guide, will always stay by your side, {NICKNAME}!

choices.text: It's my honor.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, good that you're aware of that!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Xiao, is there anything else you wanna do? We could take you on a tour of Liyue Harbor!

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: No need.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I've stayed here for much longer than I had expected. The city lights are a fine sight... but it's time for me to leave.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: The events of today occurred so abruptly. I appreciate your kindness.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The feeling's mutual. You don't have to thank me every time.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Okay.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I'll... see you next time, then.

choices.text: I'm afraid there'll be a lot to ask of you in the future too, most distinguished Paimon.
Let's stop teasing him now.
Thanks for the treat, Director.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're not allowed to leave Paimon here alone!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: To be honest... Paimon's worried about saying the wrong thing.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Let's depart. You go ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: It seems like our new friend is an expert in wine.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I deserve no such praise. I only drink for fun — it's nothing compared to your expertise.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I'm glad we're only having tea today. What if I got drunk and said something nonsensical? I'd surely become an object of ridicule to someone I've just met.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: No such thing. I wouldn't dare disrespect the director's guest.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Did you talk about anything interesting before we started the meal? Anything fun I missed out on?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Oh, we were talking about cooking.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Mr. Zhongli told us that he went on a trip to Qiaoying Village the other day and got a hold of some uncommon ingredients — tea seed oil and sesame oil. He suggested I try using those in my new dishes.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Ohhh... No wonder he left his post for so long that day.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Those ingredients would be difficult for anyone else to find.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: I guess I'll need his help next time as well.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: About you and Venti...

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Um, haha...

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Could he be... a partner in your family business?

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: That's right.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: You know how my family is. A lot of business secrets can't just be divulged at the dinner table.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Ahh, just as I thought.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, hurry! It's almost time for us to join Hu Tao for dinner!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oooh, and we'll be meeting at... Xinyue Kiosk! It's the place with a reaaaally long waitlist!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: As expected of the parlor director — always so generous! C'mon, let's go!
